$comment: Typecheck only. `noEmit` is the point: Bun runs the TypeScript directly and
Vite builds the web app, so nothing here is a build step and there is no
output to keep in sync with either of them.
This did not exist. Every type error in the repo was therefore invisible
until it became a runtime one, which is how `--ink-1` sat undefined in
seven CSS declarations and how a null `items` reached `.length` on a screen
`strict` is on and `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is off: the codebase indexes
arrays constantly (rows, comps, options) and turning it on would add
hundreds of non-null assertions that assert exactly what the surrounding
logic already guarantees. That is noise, not safety.
